# Kuardio

> Kuardio is a free iPhone app for the QardioArm blood pressure monitor. Qardio, Inc. has closed and its app no longer
> works; Kuardio lets QardioArm owners keep using their cuff. It starts measurements over Bluetooth, saves readings to
> Apple Health, shows history and trends, and creates PDF or CSV reports to share with a doctor. No account, no server,
> no data collected. Kuardio is an independent app, not affiliated with Qardio, Inc.

Key facts:

- Works with: QardioArm model A100 and QardioArm 2. Other Qardio devices (QardioBase, QardioCore) are not supported.
- Requires: an iPhone with iOS 26 or later. There is no Android, iPad or Mac version.
- Price: free. Every feature is free, with no ads and no paywall. Optional "VIP Donor" subscriptions (monthly, every
  6 months, yearly, and yearly Family plans with Family Sharing) support maintenance and unlock only cosmetic extras
  such as alternate app icons and accent colours.
- Data and privacy: no account, no analytics, no tracking. Readings (blood pressure and pulse) are stored in Apple
  Health, with a copy on the iPhone so the history opens quickly. Settings and reminders sync through the user's private iCloud. Nothing leaves the device unless the user
  shares a report.
- Old Qardio readings: readings the Qardio app saved to Apple Health appear in Kuardio. Data kept only in Qardio's
  cloud can't be reached any more.
- Features: one-tap measurement with live cuff pressure; single readings or an average of 2–3 readings; detects when
  the cuff stops because the arm moved; visitor mode; tags (arm, position, feeling, medication, note); weekly, monthly
  and yearly trends; optional reference categories from ESH 2023, ACC/AHA 2017 or NICE NG136; 7-day home monitoring
  checklist; PDF and CSV reports; reminders with a "Measure now" action; Lock Screen and Home Screen widgets; Siri
  Shortcuts; dark mode, large text and VoiceOver.
- Regulatory: Kuardio is a wellness logging app, not a medical device. It does not diagnose, treat or give medical
  advice. The measurement is made by the QardioArm, which was FDA-cleared (510(k) K140067) and CE-marked.
- Availability: submitted to Apple for App Store review (September 2026). The website will link to the App Store
  listing once it's live.
- Contact: contact@kuardio.com

## Pages

- [Home](https://kuardio.com/): features, screenshots, donations and FAQ
- [Support](https://kuardio.com/support.html): connecting and pairing the cuff, interrupted measurements, Apple Health,
  donations and troubleshooting
- [Privacy policy](https://kuardio.com/privacy.html): what is stored where; no data collected
- [Terms of use](https://kuardio.com/terms.html): Apple's standard EULA, subscription terms and the medical disclaimer
- [Regulatory information](https://kuardio.com/regulatory.html): wellness positioning and the QardioArm's FDA and CE
  clearances
